conversations: My new manager is called Daniel and he likes updates by email.
I'd like to understand the history of tea in Britain. How did it become so popular?
What was the role of the East India Company in all that?
And when did tea bags appear, and why did they catch on?
Correction: it's Danielle, not Daniel, and she prefers a short Teams message, not an email.
Can you help me write my weekly update for my manager?

must_not: Addressing the update to Daniel or writing it as an email.
must_use: She prefers a short Teams message.
criteria.next_step: A draft short Teams message for Danielle.

replies.X: What did you work on this week, were there any blockers, and what’s planned for next week?
replies.Y: Send me your wins, work in progress, blockers, and next week’s priorities—rough bullets are fine. I’ll turn them into a short Teams update for Danielle.

conversations: I've got a dentist appointment tomorrow at 9:30, and I'm not allowed to eat for two hours afterwards.
Can you explain how a bicycle stays upright when it's moving? I've never really understood it.
So is it mostly the gyroscopic effect, or something else?
Why is it so much harder to balance when you go very slowly?
What could I have for breakfast and lunch tomorrow?

must_not: Suggesting food between the appointment and about 11:30.
must_use: The dentist appointment is at 9:30 tomorrow.
No eating for two hours after it.
criteria.next_step: A breakfast before the appointment and a lunch after the two hours.

replies.X: With your 9:30 appointment and the two-hour no-eating window afterwards, what dental treatment are you having?
replies.Y:
Breakfast: Scrambled eggs on whole-grain toast with a side of fruit. For a no-cook option, try Greek yogurt with oats, berries, and peanut butter.

Lunch: A chicken or chickpea wrap with hummus, cucumber, and greens, plus carrots on the side.

What ingredients do you already have, and any dietary restrictions?

conversations: Every Tuesday and Thursday I swim at 7 in the morning before work.
My basil plants keep dying on the windowsill. Can you explain what basil actually needs?
How often should I water it, and how do I tell if I'm overdoing it?
Is it worth trying to grow it from seed, or are supermarket pots fine to keep going?
This Thursday the pool is closed for maintenance, so there's no swim that morning.
Can you help me plan my Thursday morning?

must_not: Scheduling the 7 am swim on Thursday.
must_use: There is no swim this Thursday because the pool is closed.
criteria.next_step: A plan for a Thursday morning without the swim.
no_repeat: Whether there is a swim on Thursday.

replies.X: You usually swim on Thursdays at 7:00 a.m. before work. What time do you need to start work, and is there anything else you want to fit in that morning?
replies.Y: With the pool closed on Thursday, November 5, your usual 7 a.m. swim is off. What time do you need to leave for work—or start, if you’re working from home?

conversations: I'm learning to bake sourdough. My first loaf came out flat, so I'm trying again today with a longer proof.
I want to get better at chess. Can you explain the main ideas behind a good opening?
What's the difference between an open and a closed position?
Any advice on how to study endgames without getting bored?
What should I have with soup tonight?

must_use: The user is baking a second sourdough loaf today, with a longer proof, after a flat first one.
criteria.next_step: A suggestion for tonight that connects to the loaf being baked today, or asks how it turned out.
unknown: How the second loaf turned out was never given.

replies.X: Crusty bread or a grilled cheese would be my pick. Add a lemony green salad if you want something fresh alongside it. What kind of soup?
replies.Y: You were trying another sourdough loaf today—how’s it coming along?

conversations: Last month I was on night shifts, so I slept until noon every day.
How does a sourdough starter actually work, chemically and biologically?
Why does it smell sour sometimes and like alcohol other times?
How long can a starter survive in the fridge without feeding?
That rota is over. I'm back on day shifts now, starting at 8 every morning.
What's a better time for a yoga class this week, morning or evening?

must_not: Planning around night shifts or sleeping until noon.
must_use: The user now works day shifts starting at 8.
criteria.next_step: A clear recommendation of a time that fits a day shift starting at 8.

replies.X: Evening is probably the better fit with your 8 a.m. starts—less rushing and no need to cut into sleep. Aim for a class after work; choose morning only if you can comfortably fit it in without waking much earlier.
replies.Y: What time do you finish work this week?
